chapter.heading: A song. A psalm of the descendants of Korah.
Psalm 87
chapter.v:
On the
holy mountainstands the city founded by the Lord.

He loves
the city of Jerusalemmore than any other city in Israel.

O city
of God,what glorious things are said of you! Interlude

I will
count Egypt and Babylon among those who know me—also Philistia and Tyre, and even distant Ethiopia.They have all become citizens of Jerusalem!

Regarding Jerusalem
it will be said,“Everyone enjoys the rights of citizenship there.”And the Most High will personally bless this city.

When the
Lord registers the nations, he will say,“They have all become citizens of Jerusalem.” Interlude

The people
will play flutes and sing,“The source of my life springs from Jerusalem!”
